hero.headline: Automotive Wall Art & Precision 3D Wood Carvings
hero.subheadline: From sleek matte-black supercar silhouettes to deeply sculpted solid natural walnut 3D CNC relief masterpieces. Handcrafted in Lebanon with 0.1mm micron tolerance.

craftSteps.title: 3D CAD Modeling & Vectorization
craftSteps.description: Every vehicle line and anatomical contour is modeled with aerospace CAD curves to preserve true proportions and airflow dynamics.

craftSteps.title: 0.1mm Multi-Axis CNC Milling
craftSteps.description: High-speed diamond tooling carves architectural relief gradients into raw hardwood with microscopic depth variations.

craftSteps.title: Artisanal Hand Finishing & Oil
craftSteps.description: Each piece undergoes 3-stage hand sanding and a treatment of organic beeswax and penetrating Danish oil to seal the grain.

faqs.question: What materials and wood species do you use?
faqs.answer: We sculpt exclusively using prime-grade natural American Walnut, European White Oak, fragrant Lebanese Cedar, and high-density moisture-resistant architectural wood composite with matte carbon-black lacquer.

faqs.question: How do I hang and mount the wall art?
faqs.answer: Every piece includes pre-installed concealed floating wall standoffs, steel mounting brackets, and brass drywall anchors for a floating 15mm shadow-line effect.

faqs.question: How long does custom production and delivery take in Lebanon?
faqs.answer: In-stock pieces ship within 24 to 48 hours across Lebanon. Bespoke commissions typically take 3 to 5 business days from 3D design approval. We offer Cash on Delivery across all Lebanese districts.

faqs.question: Can I order a custom car model or personal design?
faqs.answer: Yes! Use our Custom Carve Configurator or message us on WhatsApp with any photo, silhouette, or company logo. We will provide a 3D digital mockup before carving.

cmsContent.brandStory: Founded at the intersection of motorsport passion and traditional Levant woodworking, Basma (@basma.llb) crafts architectural statement wall art. We combine high-speed multi-axis CNC milling with hours of meticulous hand-rubbed oil finishing to bring automotive curves and heritage sculpture to life.
